notes: APPENDIX-ONLY SPECIFICATION, outside the protocol's main-text scope; kept because it is the only part of the paper replicable from the package (all main-text DiD data are under NDA). Outcome: log count of Goodreads reviews per title-month. Authors' code: feols(ln_num_reviews ~ post_ban*is_banned_ever | title + running_month, se = 'hetero') on gr_reviews_data.csv restricted to months_since_first_ban in [-4, 6]; fixest drops is_banned_ever and the interaction as collinear (controls have post_ban = 0 throughout), so the reported 'PostBan x Banned' coefficient is the post_ban coefficient. Panel: 126 titles x 24 months (running_month 12-35); 22 banned titles with first-ban months 19-25 (7 cohorts: 3,2,3,4,7,2,1 titles), 104 never-banned controls kept for all 24 months; banned titles kept only in their [-4, +6] relative-month window (2,738 title-months). Treatment absorbing, no switch-offs, no always-treated. Prepared data: gr_reviews_panel.rds = the package CSV plus integer title_id and ban_group (first-ban running_month, 0 = never). DEVIATION: authors report heteroskedasticity-robust SEs; run_spec.R clusters by title.
